Local Section Evaluator.role: Computes local state transitions within isolated subdomains U_i.

Colimit Gluing Synthesizer.role: Glues mutually compatible local sections into a single global system state.

leaderboard.operational_rule: Subsystems lacking negative feedback damping when approaching saturation are throttled and re-balanced at compile time.
